inlet.description: evi.logahr~ will follow this input value with the given attack, hold and release times.
Amount of time the envelope takes to attack. evi.logahr~ is logarithmic and does not attack in this time exactly.
Amount of time to hold the envelope after the attack stage and before the release stage (in milliseconds).
Amount of time the envelope takes to release. evi.logahr~ is logarithmic and does not release in this time exactly.
